QuestInfo.name: Lioner Stone
QuestInfo.0: #p3000018# found a monster that gives a special Essence Stone. Listen to his story.
QuestInfo.1: The next stone comes from a monster called the #o5120002# that hangs around the #m200010121# in Orbis. It's so cute! But it must be destroyed...
QuestInfo.2: #p3000018# is such a creep! That thing was adooorable!

0.0: #h0#, I found a most enticing and unusual Essence Stone.\r\n#L0##bI didn't know you even know words that big!#l\n#k
0.1: Quiet, you! Now... this one's going to be hard, because the #o5120002# creatures that hold them are REALLY cute. Like, seriously, it's ridiculous.\r\n#L0##bYou want me to hurt cute things just so you can eat?!#l\n#k
0.2: Do not be dissuaded by its cuteness! It's only manipulating you into not obeying my manipulations!

yes.0: Good, then go destroy their adorable little faces and bring me the #t4033434#.

no.0: You're way cuter, though. You know that, right?

1.0: I can smell the adorable flavor from here! \r\n#L0##bYa know, maybe my Eskie isn't the horrible old man I think he is. #l\n#k
1.1: What's that supposed to mean?! I've been nothing but a gentleman! \r\n#L0##bNo, It's just... I didn't expect anything you called 'cute' to actually be... ya know... cute. #l\n#k
1.2: Is that a compliment? I think you're pretty cute too, you know? Did you know that?

yes.0: Is it wrong that knowing how cute that #o5120002# was is making this more delicious?

item.0: Get the #t4033434# from one of the #o5120002# monsters that appears at the #m200010121# in the Orbis region.
